[[File:Stargate TCG original logo.png|thumb|right|180px|Original Stargate TCG logo.]]
The '''Stargate Trading Card Game''' adapts ''Stargate SG-1''. Sony Online Entertainment launched the digital game in April 2007, and Comic Images published the physical edition.<ref name="stargate-launch">[https://sony.mediaroom.com/2007-04-27-STARGATE-Online-Trading-Card-Game-Now-Available STARGATE Online Trading Card Game Now Available], Sony Online Entertainment, 27 April 2007. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20221005001606/https://sony.mediaroom.com/2007-04-27-STARGATE-Online-Trading-Card-Game-Now-Available Internet Archive].</ref> The original rulebook credits [[Evan Lorentz]], Paul Dennen, [[Chuck Kallenbach]], Scott Martins and Chris Woods with game design and development.<ref name="stargate-rules">[https://karcianki.pl/files/sg/Stargate.pdf Stargate Trading Card Game rulebook], Sony Online Entertainment and Comic Images, 2007, p. 40. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160802190545/http://karcianki.pl/files/sg/Stargate.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Players assemble teams, send them on missions and alternate between advancing their own team and opposing the other player's missions.<ref name="stargate-launch" /> Physical sets included ''SG-1'' and ''System Lords'' in 2007 and ''Rise of the Ori'' in 2008.<ref name="stargate-products">[https://www.ccgtrader.net/games/stargate-tcg/ Stargate TCG], CCG Trader, original product list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260316091212/https://www.ccgtrader.net/games/stargate-tcg/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="stargate-ori">[https://karcianki.pl/files/sg/Stargate%20-%20Rise%20of%20the%20Ori.pdf Stargate Trading Card Game: Rise of the Ori rulebook], Sony Online Entertainment and Comic Images, 2008, p. 44. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160803002408/http://karcianki.pl/files/sg/Stargate%20-%20Rise%20of%20the%20Ori.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Playing online ==

[[TCGMix]] features [https://kawooshonline.com/ Kawoosh Online], a separate browser revival.<ref name="kawoosh-online">[https://kawooshonline.com/ Kawoosh Online]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107193401/https://kawooshonline.com/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="catalog" />
